design.motif: A temperate butterfly garden without asserting species: long gently serrated buddleia leaves, a small branching nettle-like host-leaf spray and a single tiny desaturated flower cluster. Keep all petals under two percent of the canvas. No butterflies, wings or rainbow gradients.

description.en: Long gently serrated buddleia leaves, a small branching nettle-like host-leaf spray and a single tiny desaturated flower cluster.
description.zh: 醉鱼草长叶与细小寄主植物叶丛围出停驻处，只有一簇低调花影，把彩色位置留给蝴蝶原标。

design.rationale: The existing animal/bird identity determines a plausible broad botanical setting; no species claim is added. Product category does not override an approved animal identity.

description.en: A closer look at your Twitter / X activity, with analytics and AI-powered reports.
description.zh: 深入查看 Twitter / X 动态，用数据分析与 AI 报告理解自己的内容。

purpose.en: Collect X / Twitter and custom-source content into watchlists, then read, translate, and save links from one timeline.
purpose.zh: 将 X / Twitter 与自定义来源的内容按关注列表收集，在同一时间线中阅读、翻译和保存链接。

rights: Owner-commissioned Azure OpenAI generated decoration under applicable provider terms. No third-party reference image or font was submitted. Existing Logo, font and product rights are unchanged. Do not describe raster output as handmade SVG or assert exclusive trademark rights.

contrast.method: WCAG relative luminance on every native RGBA pixel composited over actual Hexly normal/hover surfaces, before the left-edge mask. Text remains fully opaque.

publication: Export-time record. Upload receipts and the site release establish subsequent publication.
